strengths: Concrete station scenes (morning rush, transfer pressure, luggage)
Mostly calm magazine tone without wonder-clickbait

issues.problem: Stock opener and a slightly sermonizing close (“one step, one lane, one commute at a time”).
issues.suggestion: Sharpen the first line; shorten the final cadence if it feels slogan-like.

issues.problem: Occasional explanatory stacking (“The deeper point remains…”) reads a bit editorial-template.
issues.suggestion: Prefer scene → implication without meta signposting.
